label: Vagus Nerve Stimulation in Cardiac Disease: A Systematic Review of Randomized Clinical Trials.
summary: Cardiac arrhythmias remain a major cause of morbidity and mortality, and current therapies have notable limitations. Vagus nerve stimulation (VNS), which modulates autonomic tone, has emerged as a potential adjunctive treatment. This systematic review evaluated the efficacy of invasive and noninvasive VNS in patients with atrial fibrillation, heart failure, myocardial infarction, and other rhythm disorders.
